automation_policy.principle: Full agentic send is allowed only when content is a signed template or a standing protocol, reversible, and non-diagnostic.

candidates.why: Fixed questions, no advice, fired on visit.closed. Sender = practice.
candidates.gate: template_id signed by org.owner; no free-text clinical replies auto-answered

candidates.class: HITL_REQUIRED unless protocol_id already signed for that visit_type
candidates.why: Clinical content. INV-3. Standing after-visit instruction packs can graduate to AUTO_TEMPLATE.
candidates.gate: protocol version pinned; first send of a new protocol is HITL

candidates.class: AUTO_TEMPLATE for logistics/intake link; HITL_REQUIRED for customized clinical prep
candidates.why: A booking is not consent to be clinically coached by a model.
candidates.gate: chatbot may collect intake and explain parking. It may not interpret symptoms.

candidates.why: Surfaces in the provider pane as a draft from Session Prep / Scribe. Not patient-facing. Clinician walking in unread is their choice; product does not mark it reviewed.
candidates.gate: org toggle auto_publish_to_provider_pane only after measured accuracy; never auto-sends to patient

candidates.why: Existing Cosmas generator. Provider attests the note. Never auto-signs the chart.

tenancy.Org: a covered-entity or BA-scoped legal practice, not a brand

MCD.parent: brand + shared IT paid by corporate
MCD.workforce_clinical: 1099 providers: visit, note, Athena clinical requests
MCD.workforce_ops: MCD staff + vendors: middle and back office
MCD.do_not: treat 1099 as the CardChase approver by default; they do not run the back office

patterns.solo_or_small_independent: 1 Org, 1 computer, 1-3 provider seats, physician is default approver
patterns.single_legal_group_e.g_10_derms: 1 Org, 1 computer, N provider seats each with private home/stream; consults are F-8 tickets between seats; SKU charged per provider
patterns.mcd_network: 4 Orgs from 4 BAAs; computers follow entity not 1099; network_tenant toggle ON; ops approves chase; 1099 attests SOAP

rigid: Org is a BAA / covered-entity boundary
Seat is a bound human login
network_tenant is a toggle default OFF
flexibility.rule: do not fork code per specialty or network

record_ladder.rule: Launch is not gated on full EHR writeback. Each skill declares a minimum ladder level.

levels.L0: No EHR. Streams, F-8, SchedulePort only, notes as Cosmas drafts, chase = image + human verify.
levels.L1: EHR read: patient match, coverage-if-present, appointments-if-present.
levels.L2: Document attach: SOAP PDF / card image into the chart as a file.
levels.L4: Signed note writeback. Clinician still attests.

record_ladder.marketplace_cardchase: L2 minimum to look real on Athena; L3 preferred

invariants_os.INV-OS-SUBMIT: Named provider or account owner submits all system-of-record writes. Cosmas prepares. Never auto-submit notes, claims, Rx, coverage packages, orders.
